chain.title: Inferium Essence
chain.desc: First base material: smelt Inferium Ore (spawns Y -32 to 64 in the overworld) or pick it up as a common mob drop.

chain.title: Prosperity Shard
chain.desc: Second base material: smelt Prosperity Ore, which generates from Y 24 down to -60 in the overworld.

chain.title: Inferium Seeds
chain.desc: Craft 8 Inferium Essence around Wheat Seeds; planting these makes Inferium fully renewable instead of mined.

chain.title: Infusion Crystal
chain.desc: Craft 4 Prosperity Shards and 4 Inferium Essence around a diamond; a limited-durability catalyst for combining 4 essences into 1 of the next tier.

chain.title: Infusion Altar
chain.desc: Craft 2 gold ingots, 1 red wool and 4 stone; place it with 8 Infusion Pedestals (same materials) to form the multiblock that crafts resource seeds, activated by Wand or redstone.

chain.title: Prosperity Seed Base
chain.desc: Craft 4 Prosperity Shards around Wheat Seeds; the center ingredient of every crafted resource seed.

chain.title: Prudentium Essence
chain.desc: Tier 2 essence: craft 4 Inferium Essence around an Infusion Crystal.

chain.title: Iron Seeds
chain.desc: Representative resource seed: surround a Seed Base with iron ingots and the crop's tier essence (crafting grid or Infusion Altar) to grow iron for free.

chain.title: Growth Accelerator
chain.desc: Craft 4 Inferium Essence, 4 stone and an Inferium Gemstone for 3 accelerators; stacked under farmland they add random growth ticks to the crop above.

chain.title: Tertium Essence
chain.desc: Tier 3 essence: craft 4 Prudentium Essence around an Infusion Crystal.

chain.title: Imperium Essence
chain.desc: Tier 4 essence: craft 4 Tertium Essence around an Infusion Crystal.

chain.title: Supremium Essence
chain.desc: Tier 5 essence: craft 4 Imperium Essence around an Infusion Crystal; unlocks the highest normal seed and gear tier.

chain.title: Master Infusion Crystal
chain.desc: Craft 4 Prosperity Shards and 4 Supremium Essence around a Supremium Gemstone; an unbreakable Infusion Crystal for all future tier upgrades.

chain.title: Soulstone
chain.desc: Mine Soulstone veins in the Nether (Soulium Ore spawns inside them) and smelt the cobble; the stone of the mod's soul-tech branch.

chain.title: Soulium Ingot
chain.desc: Craft a Prosperity Ingot (4 shards around an iron ingot) with 2 Soulium Dust smelted from Nether Soulium Ore.

chain.title: Soulium Dagger
chain.desc: Craft a golden sword with 2 Soulium Ingots and 2 Soulium Dust; killing mobs with it fills Soul Jars with the souls needed for mob seeds.

chain.title: Machine Frame
chain.desc: Craft 4 iron ingots, 4 redstone and stone; the base block of all Mystical Agriculture machines.

chain.title: Harvester
chain.desc: Craft a Machine Frame with iron, 2 Soulium Ingots and 2 Diamond Scythes; a solid-fueled machine that auto-harvests and replants crops.

chain.title: Tinkering Table
chain.desc: Craft 2 Soulium Dust with 6 stone; used to socket Augments into essence tools and armor.

chain.title: Supremium Ingot
chain.desc: Craft a Prosperity Ingot with 2 Supremium Essence; the material for tier 5 tools, armor and the upgrades fed into awakening.

chain.title: Awakening Altar
chain.desc: Craft 2 gold ingots, orange wool and 4 Soulstone; forms a multiblock with 4 Awakening Pedestals and 4 Essence Vessels that consumes Air, Earth, Water and Fire essences from elemental crops.

chain.title: Cognizant Dust
chain.desc: Dropped by the Wither and Ender Dragon when killed with an essence weapon enchanted with Mystical Enlightenment; required for every awakening recipe.

chain.title: Awakened Supremium Essence
chain.desc: Awaken a Supremium Block on the altar with 4 Cognizant Dust and 10 of each elemental essence, then uncraft the block into 9 essence.

chain.title: Awakened Supremium Ingot
chain.desc: Craft a Prosperity Ingot with 2 Awakened Supremium Essence; endgame material whose gear is finished on the Awakening Altar with 40 of each elemental essence per piece.

notes: Verified against MysticalAgriculture-1.20.1-7.0.24.jar (Modrinth, latest 1.20.1). item_count_in_jar=250 is the intersection of item model stems with explicit item./block. lang keys; crop seeds and per-crop essences (410 seed recipe files, ~400 extra model stems) use dynamically generated names, so mysticalagriculture:inferium_seeds and mysticalagriculture:iron_seeds were instead verified via their item model files plus their recipe files (recipes/inferium_seeds.json, recipes/seed/crafting/iron.json) - both are real registered items. Deliberately omitted: all other per-resource seeds/essences, color/decor variants (soulstone brick set, witherproof blocks), per-tier duplicates of farmland/furnaces/watering cans/gear, and the soul-jar-hungry Soulium Spawner and Soul Extractor (optional side content); the Seed Reprocessor (iron + 2 Soulium Ingots + iron hoe around a Machine Frame, converts 1 spare seed into 2 of its essence) was trimmed to stay within the entry cap and could be swapped in for the Harvester. Elemental (air/earth/water/fire) crops are gated behind Agglomeratio materials (e.g. air_agglomeratio = glass bottle + gravel + dirt + clay) and feed the Awakening Altar via Essence Vessels. Recipe ingredient counts above are literal from the jar's recipe JSONs; seed recipes are conditional on config (seed_crafting_recipes_enabled / crop_enabled) but enabled by default. No custom dimensions and no kill-step entities registered by this mod (Wither/Ender Dragon are vanilla; kill:wither could be added by the integrator if desired, but cognizant_dust already covers that milestone as an item).
